explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/852, second half of the question: is h(x) = o(log x)? The Lean statement: for every ε > 0 and all large real x, every run of H pairwise distinct consecutive prime gaps starting at an index n < x has H ≤ ε·log x, i.e. h(x) ≤ ε log x eventually. This is the correct unpacking of the little-o statement without defining h. Faithful.
